about: The dropdown's options of U1c, as every renderer offers them. A `typed` dropdown takes any text; it offers the values its field already has in the database (`values`, as the shell gives them, with repeats and empty ones): each value once, empty text left out, those that contain the typed text (trimmed, ignoring case; all of them when nothing is typed), sorted ignoring case and then as written. A `search` dropdown filters the records a reference can point at (`options`, each with its id, its text and the texts of the fields it shows) as text is typed: a record is offered when every word typed is in its text or in a field it shows, ignoring case; in the order the records came, all of them when nothing is typed.
